competences.description: Attacks the enemy and creates a Shield equal to 10% of your MAX HP on the ally with the worst HP condition for 2 turns.

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit decreases their Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance and increases their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. Each hit ignores effects that resist death and stuns them for 1 turn. When attacking on your turn while [Final Lightning] is on cooldown, ignores effects that resist death and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with an 80% chance.

effets.description: Ignores all effects that resist death
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
